items.item_text: Experience using Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Publisher), Google Applications (Calendar, Forms, Sheets, Docs, and Drive).
Flexibility to respond to changing priorities.

In collaboration with the Department Chair and Business Officer, coordinates the preparation and distribution of materials for academic personnel cases, including those for faculty tenure and promotion cases requiring external review. Works with Business Officer to organize and prepare cases for faculty personnel reviews. Updates bio-bibliographies, curriculum vitae, and payroll records, and is responsible for compiling faculty research and teaching files for personnel reviews. For tenure and promotion cases, works with chair and faculty candidates to develop list of potential reviewers. Prepares case materials packet to be sent to extramural reviewers; distributes material to reviewers. Tracks the following actions: soliciting extramural reviewers for the case(s); sending materials to the extramural reviewers; and receiving the extramural reviewer letters. Assists Department Chair in following up with extramural reviewers to obtain their recommendation letters in a timely fashion. Prepares confidential coded reviewer list(s) for tenure and promotion case(s). Serves as a resource for Department Chair in interpreting Academic Personnel policy. Updates faculty records using UC Path and AP Folio.
Possess and utilize superior judgment and initiative.

Provides analytical support to the Department Chair on a wide range of topics under pressure of frequent deadlines including, but not limited, to gathering current and historical data; benchmarking practices and numbers for other departments and universities; and other projects. Analyzes and prepares spreadsheets, graphs, and reports for the Department Chair. Drafts documents for the Chair's consideration. Researches, compiles and summarizes. Coordinates projects efficiently and effectively. Manages special projects or actions for the Chair from start to completion. Projects may include researching and analyzing data; drafting documents; and proposing recommendations for the Chair's consideration. Coordinates projects efficiently and effectively. Tracks correspondence, action items, and special projects. Shares progress and results with the Department Chair in a timely manner.

In collaboration with the Department Chair and Business Officer, coordinates the administration of all faculty recruitments. Coordinates faculty/lecturer recruitment activities such as preparing Search Plans in UC Recruit and placing advertisements for faculty positions for temporary lecturers and tenure track/tenured faculty. Establishes and maintains confidential applicant files and the UC Recruit search database. Assists search committee and department chair in using UC Recruit and interpreting University Policy. Serves as administrative contact on the search committee, working closely with the committee chair to ensure applications are reviewed by appropriate faculty and affirmative action guidelines are followed. Updates UC Recruit to accurately track candidates throughout the recruitment application process and ensure that correct data are recorded in the system. Compiles data (including affirmative action data for search committee and reports required by the campus.) Organizes finalist visits, including scheduling campus interviews and appointments for the finalists with department faculty and University officials. Fields questions from applicants and answers in a sensitive and timely manner. Prepares all recruitment correspondence, including the solicitation of external reviews.

Plans and coordinates department receptions and events, including annual department awards ceremony and reception, annual honors colloquium, annual faculty retreat, outside speakers, and department socials. Maintains department events calendar and consults with faculty hosts and students on scheduling outside speakers and department events. Coordinates logistics of department events including booking hotel stays, arranging travel, coordinating meals, and reserving rooms for events. Creates flyers and promotional materials to publicize department events; distributes flyers within the Department and on campus. Serves as the primary administrative contact for a department event or speaker. Makes sure that the event/speaker space is set up per specifications. Coordinates and sets up technical needs, and supports department's audio-visual (A/V) needs including Zoom/Skype teleconferencing.

Coordinates with Development to maintain contact with donors. Assists faculty with dissemination, administration, and distribution of scholarships and prizes on a quarterly and annual basis. Consults with the Department Chair and the Alumni Office for email distribution of the alumni email(s). Serves as departmental liaison with the Office of Public Affairs for the release of newsworthy department information. Assists with preparation of flyers and announcements publicizing departmental colloquia and other department events; distributes flyers and electronic announcements to publicize colloquia. Assists Undergraduate Program Coordinator and Graduate Program Coordinator with faculty communication as needed.

Provides administrative support to the Department Chair. Serves as the department contact for the Development Office. Requests regular giving reports and prepares recognition letters for the Chair to send to donors. Maintains records of donors giving to the department. Assists with development solicitation and donor recognition efforts. Serves as the Department Safety Representative. Follows campus guidelines for Department Safety Representatives and implements Department Safety Plans. Enters purchase order information in Gateway online procurement system. Serves as backup to the Business Officer for UC Path transactions. Coordinates and maintains department Google calendar system. Manages the file structure and permissions for the department's Box account.
Other duties as assigned. Must be flexible and able to incorporate new tasks and projects as required by department needs.

Covered Individuals: A Covered Individual includes anyone designated as Personnel or Students under this Policy who physically access a University Facility or Program in connection with their employment, appointment, or education/training. A person accessing a Healthcare Location as a patient, or an art, athletics, entertainment, or other publicly accessible venue at a Location as a member of the public, is not a Covered Individual.
Must have basic photo editing and design skills.
Effective oral and written communication skills.
Ability to work under pressure of deadlines.
Ability to act professionally and with confidentially and professionally.
